answer: Velvet Room Admission prices coordination by charging each new identity a fee equal to the median fee paid by the identities it transacts with. A raven flag marks clusters whose members repeatedly pay only each other, triggering a rising fee multiplier for the whole cluster. Lotus credits earned through external transactions offset fees, so isolated fake identities pay full price while real participants earn relief. An attacker running N sybils must pay roughly N times the median coordination fee, making large fake swarms costly.
